name: rosefire
scope: Original rain-polished PBR stone shaders, world-anchored stained-light caustics, twilight veil sky, woven Wardglass and pooled actual-teleport landing echoes. Reversible controller-accessible visual profiles, reduced-motion and AR-safe policy; preserves First Bell, Oath, saved expeditions, audio and all modes.
saveCompatibility: Existing permanent profiles and v0.9 Pilgrims Rest checkpoints retain their keys and generator. Optional Oath state restores through the same validated envelope. Hand latches are not restored; continued runs wait paused for explicit input. Practice and AR do not replace scored checkpoints.
hardwareStatus: Browser and emulated-controller acceptance are used for publication. Physical Quest 3 ergonomics, comfort, audio balance and performance still require hardware playtesting. The authored route reuses the existing architecture; a measured 20-30 minute production slice is not claimed.
